statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient presents with episodes of dizziness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis codes are I34.0, R00.2, and R42
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring CPT 93229 was ordered
The procedure was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmias
The procedure was ordered to assess for rhythm disturbances contributing to the patient's clinical presentation
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
